Description:
A gentle creature who prefers the calm waters of Eversong Woods. While the waters may be straightforward for your average Angler to cast, this particular fish is only available to the most perceptive of them.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods
- Harandar

Fishing Pools:
- Blossoming Torrent

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.
